craft_notes: Sthāyin: skull-seat (pareekshā-method). Sanskrit: kapālāntar mano nyasya...lakṣayet laṣyam uttamam → L4 keeps placement then marking. Rows: row 3 (from-firmness→mark). Close: mark (the marked-mark pun: lakṣayet laṣyam — kept). Rejected: 'third eye' — killed: mark kept (never named); 'skull-gazing' — mind placed, not gazing.

lines: Mind in skull placed, half-closed-eyed standing:
from mind's firmness in order — mark the highest mark.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kapālāntar mano nyasya tiṣṭhan mīlitalocanaḥ | krameṇa manaso dārḍhyāt lakṣayet laṣyam uttamam

reads_against.argmap: What is placed inside the skull? → From mind's firmness the highest mark is marked.
c1_essence: Mind in skull: from firmness the highest mark is marked.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness with piercing resolve)
